current.text: He is set to start at center for the Clippers over Brook Lopez. He started over Lopez in preseason scrimmages and has basically told reporters he is starting.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser is out injured. Brook Lopez is projected as the backup center.
Experts doubt the starting job will last all season. He likely starts only until Yanic Konan Niederhauser returns, so his value should fade later in the year.
His upside is a 25-minute starter who gives a big FG% boost, blocks and solid rebounds. He could be a top 150 player early in the season.
He should be drafted late in every 12-team league as a late-round flier. One expert took him with his last pick in a mock draft and sees a longer leash for him than for Jalen Smith.
Foul trouble is a risk to his minutes as a starter.
Ty Lue makes odd rotation choices and then changes them. The projected Clippers starting five is not certain.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks and have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: He never developed a three-point shot and makes no threes.
He tore his Achilles about two years ago. He also got hurt at the end of last season.
One expert does not rate him as a very good player.
Josh says the Clippers coach never gives his centers heavy minutes.

note: He costs nothing: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. That makes him a 1 USD end-of-auction flier for FG% (projected 62.6% with z +1.3 against the pool) and blocks, if he holds the starting center job. He gives you no threes and costs a little in FT%, so his value depends on his minutes. Early on, check whether he keeps starting over Brook Lopez, whether his minutes climb from 16.5 toward 25 despite fouls, and when Konan Niederhauser returns, since that is the likely point to drop him.
